Commentary.Commentary: 201 is the target on a wicket which is gripping just a little. Not going to be easy for the visitors to chase this down, they will need to bat out of their skin if they are to do so. Bangladesh on the other hand, will back themselves to defend this. The chase in a while, stay tuned.

Not a lot you can write about a bowling attack which has conceded 200 runs. Right from the word go, the bowlers took a pounding. The pacers were taken to the cleaners. The spinners though did bowl with some control, there was some assistance for them but poor show from the pace bowlers meant the visitors are going to be chasing a huge target.

An excellent performance from the hosts! Their openers set the platform with a powerful 92-run stand. Tamim missed out on a half ton but Das did get to his. The two however, departed in quick succession and Zimbabwe did have a sniff to crawl back into the game then but Rahim and Sarkar had different ideas. The two counter-attacked and added 40 in no time. Rahim departed but Sarkar continued hitting the bowlers to all parts of the ground. He batted with a strike rate of close 200 and ensured the hosts reach the 200-run mark.
SIX! 20 runs have come from the last over! Short delivery on middle, Sarkar pulls it over mid-wicket for a maximum. BANGLADESH FINISH WITH 200/3!
SIX! That is huge! Full delivery on middle, Sarkar heaves it over long on for a biggie.
Full delivery on middle, Mahmudullah drives it through mid on for a single.
Fifty for Soumya Sarkar! It is his 2nd T20I fifty! Full delivery on off, Sarkar drives it through covers for a single.
BEATEN! On a good length and outside off, Sarkar looks to defend but misses it.
SIX! Great way to start the last over! Full delivery on off, Sarkar lofts it over long off for a maximum.
A couple to end! 10 from it in the end! One more ball down the leg side, Mahmudullah swings but it goes off the glove towards fine leg and two is taken.
FOUR! Not off the middle but Bangladesh won't care! This is short and on the body, Mahmudullah is hurried into the pull shot. It goes off the glove and down to the fine leg fence.
Another single! On a length and around off, Sarkar flat-bats it down to long on for one.
Just a single again! A good slower one, Mahmudullah comes down the track, he swings but is a touch early in the shot. He mistimes it towards mid-wicket for one.
Sarkar moves right across and Tiripano bowls it wide outside off. Sarkar looks to go over the leg side but he gets an inside edge on the leg side for one.
Mahmudullah makes room and Tiripano follows him with a length ball on the pads, it is worked towards fine leg for one.
FOUR! Nicely played! Short delivery on leg, Sarkar pulls it towards fine leg for a boundary.
Full toss on middle, Sarkar looks to big but gets a bottom edge on this one.
On a length on middle, Mahmudullah flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Short delivery on leg, Sarkar pulls it towards fine leg where Taylor misfields and concedes a single.

Play and a miss! Intelligently bowled by Mpofu. He sees Sarkar shuffling across his stumps and he follows him up. Sarkar goes for the loft but is cramped for the room and the ball in the end goes past the outside edge.
Quick run! Mahmudullah shuffles across and Mpofu bowls a yorker on middle, Mahmudullah swings but it takes the inside edge and hits the pad. It rolls towards the keeper and a run is taken.

SIX! Amazing shot! Tiripano bowls a low full toss outside off, Sarkar who is playing with a sore shoulder, still goes for the slog and he drags it perfectly and gets it right in the gap between mid-wicket and long on. The ball goes on the full over the fence for a biggie.
Tiripano bowls a slower short ball on middle, Mahmudullah waits and pulls it towards fine leg. The batsmen cross ends.
Length delivery on off, Mahmudullah flicks it through mid-wicket. The batsmen get two runs.
Full again on off, Soumya drives it towards covers where the fielder makes a fine stop. The batsmen take a single.
TOP EDGE AND FOUR! Full delivery outside off, Sarkar looks to go big but gets a top edge. It goes over short third man for a boundary. 150 up for Bangladesh.
Full delivery outside off, Sarkar lofts it over point. The fielder in the deep does well to stop it. The batsmen pick up a couple.
Donald Tiripano is back on. 2-0-13-0 are his figures so far.
A single to end an action-packed over! 22 from it and a wicket. Full and on the pads, Sarkar works it through square leg for one.
Mahmudullah is the new man in.

OUT! In the air... taken! Mpofu has the last laugh! He was taken for plenty in this over but he has something to be happy about now as a wicket is taken. Mpofu comes around the wicket and bowls it full and outside off, Rahim swings but mistimes it up in the air towards mid off where Williams takes an easy catch.
SIX! Rahim takes full toll of the Free Hit! A gift for him. A full toss on middle, Rahim swivels and hammers it well over the square leg fence. Second in the over. This is a massive one.
Free Hit time!

Now a no ball! This is poor from Mpofu! He oversteps. Bowls this one very full outside off, Sarkar looks to paddle scoop it but misses to get hit on the pads. It rolls on the leg side. A leg bye taken. Free Hit coming up.
Another wide! One more very full ball outside off, Sarkar looks to carve it but misses. Wide given.
Way too short now and it bounces well over the batter's head. Wided.

FOUR! That is poor bowling with third man up in the ring! Shorter and outside off, Sarkar says thank you very much, he guides it past that fielder and bags another boundary. 11 from the first three balls.
On the shorter side, Rahim pulls it all along the ground this time. The fine leg is at the fence so just a run.
SIX! All the way! Welcome back into the attack, Mpofu! It is a slower one on middle, Rahim goes down on one knee and slog sweeps it over the square leg fence. Perfect start to the over.
Short delivery on middle, Rahim pulls it through square leg for a run.
Flighted delivery on off, Sarkar plays it towards point for a single.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Sarkar defends it off the back foot.
Loopy delivery on off, Rahim plays it towards covers for a single.
Floated delivery on off, Sarkar punches it towards the off side for a single.
FOUR! Nice improvisation! Tossed up delivery on off, Sarkar plays a reverse sweep towards third man for a boundary.
On middle, Sarkar flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Floated delivery on off, Rahim punches it towards point for a single.
Full toss on middle, Sarkar flicks it through square leg for a run.
Tossed up delivery on off, Rahim plays a reverse sweep towards short third man where the fielder makes a good stop.
Floated on leg, tucked towards the leg side for a single.
SIX! That is humongous. Floated on off, Sarkar slogs it over the fence at mid-wicket for a maximum.
Mushfiqur Rahim is the new man in.

OUT! LBW! It is three reds and Liton Das has to walk back, he takes the only review along with him! Flighted delivery on middle, Das looks to flick but gets hit on the pads. The bowler appeals for lbw and the umpire raises his finger. Liton Das thinks for a while and then starts walking but is stopped by his partner who asks him to take the review. Replays roll in and first up it is the Ultra Edge which shows that there is no inside edge. Next up is the Ball Tracker which shows that impact is in line and it is hitting the middle stump. BANGLADESH ALSO LOSE THEIR ONLY REVIEW! A good innings from Das comes to an end. Zimbabwe have got rid of both the openers. This is a good passage of play for them.

Das has been given out LBW and he is walking back to the hut but suddenly he stops and signals the 'T'. Let's see what the replays show. Yes, what Liton was doing earlier was right as the Ball Tracker shows it to be three reds.
FOUR! Nicely played! Loopy delivery on middle, Das plays a paddle sweep towards fine leg for a boundary.
Floated delivery on middle, Sarkar flicks it towards fine leg for a single.
Tossed up delivery outside off, Sarkar looks to defend but misses it due to the turn on this one.
Loopy delivery on middle, Das looks to defend but gets an inside edge. It goes towards fine leg for a single.
Flighted delivery on middle, Das flicks it through mid-wicket. The batsmen get two runs.
Sikandar Raza is back on.
Floated delivery on middle, Das sweeps it towards square leg for a single.
Floated delivery on off, Das defends it off the back foot.
Loopy delivery on middle, Sarkar drives it through mid on for a run.
Full delivery on middle, Sarkar drives it towards mid on.
Tossed up delivery on off, Das plays it towards point for a single.
Flighted delivery on middle, Das looks to sweep but misses it and gets hit on the thigh pad. The bowler appeals for lbw but the umpire shakes his head.
BEATEN! Tossed up delivery outside off, Sarkar looks to guide but misses it.
Loopy delivery on middle, Das flicks it towards square leg for a run. That also brings up his fifty. Das continues from where he left in the ODIs.
Flighted delivery on middle, Sarkar flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up delivery on off, Das guides it towards third man for a run.
Soumya Sarkar is the new man in.

OUT! It is a legal delivery and Tamim continues his walk back to the pavillion. Madhevere gets his maiden T20I wicket. It is floated on off, Tamim gives the charge but is nowhere near the pitch of the ball as he slices it off the toe end of the bat. The ball goes high up in the air and the man at extra cover, skipper Sean Williams settles himself under it and takes the catch. Tamim is not going anywhere as he has been asked to wait as the umpires are checking for a front foot No Ball. The replays roll in and it looks like Wesley has overstepped here but the third umpire is not convinced from the initial replays and asks for more angles. Finally he gives the marching order for Tamim Iqbal.
Now then, they have gone upstairs to check if the bowler has overstepped! Looks very close.
Tossed up delivery on off, Das drives it through point for a single.
Wesley Madhevere is back on.
Floated on off, Das pushes it to mid off for a single.
Flatter and on off, punched towards covers for single.
Floated on off, Das pushes it to mid on for a single.
Tossed up on leg and Iqbal tucks it to the leg side for a single.
FOUR! That's got enough legs to reach the fence. It is floated on leg  and Tamim paddles it fine down the leg side and the ball beats the chase of the short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Iqbal looks to flick but gets hit on the pads.
Floated delivery on off, Das punches it towards point.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Iqbal punches it towards long on for a single.
Short delivery on middle, Das pulls it through mid-wicket for a run.
Floated delivery on off, Tamim comes down the track and drives it through covers for a single.
Flighted delivery on off, Iqbal punches it to covers.
Loopy delivery on off, Das plays it towards point for a run.
Sikandar Raza is back on.
Flighted delivery on middle, Liton flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.

SIX! That is huge! Whatever shot this man plays goes over the ropes. It is floated on middle and leg, Das sweeps it high and over the deep square leg fence where the fielder was interested but it goes over with him as he catches it. Das gets a maximum.
Loopy delivery on off, Das punches it towards the off side.
Short and outside off, Iqbal cuts it through point for a single.
BEATEN! Flighted delivery outside off, Iqbal looks to play a reverse sweep but misses it.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Das works it towards fine leg for a single.
Sean Williams is on.
Floated delivery on middle, Das plays a paddle sweep towards fine leg for a single.

NOT OUT! Waste of a review there by Zimbabwe. IT IS INDEED PITCHING OUTSIDE LEG! Madhevere took that in desperation. It was never going to be out as even the naked eye could tell that it is pitched way outside leg. It is bowled flatter and around leg, Das rocks onto the back foot to pull it but he gets beaten and is hit on the front pad. There is an appeal but the umpire is unmoved. Wesley convinces his skipper to take the review and the replays roll in. First the front foot is checked and Wesley is fine on that. Next comes the Ultra Edge which says that no bat involved now its the turn of Ball Trackert to tell where it is pitching and it says that it is pitched outside leg. Zimbabwe lose their only review.
Zimbabwe review again but this does not seem out and not even close! It looks like it has pitched outside leg.
WIDE! Tossed up delivery down the leg side, Das lets it go.
On middle, Iqbal plays a paddle sweep towards fine leg for a single.
Loopy delivery on middle, Das flicks it through square leg for a single.
Flighted delivery on middle, Tamim punches it towards long on for a run.
SIX! Good use of the feet! Tossed up delivery on middle, Iqbal comes down the track and lofts it over long off for a maximum.
Wesley Madhevere is on.
Full delivery on middle, Iqbal flicks it through square leg for a single. BANGLADESH END WITH 59/0 at the end of the Powerplay.
Full and on middle, Liton drives it through mid on for a run.
SIX! Amazing shot! Full delivery on middle, Das lofts it over mid-wicket for a maximum.
On a length on off, Tamim taps it towards covers for a single. 50 up for Bangladesh.

NOT OUT! UMPIRE'S CALL! The bowler is lucky there as it could have gone either way. It is bowled on a length and on middle and leg, Das looks to flick it to the leg side but gets beaten and is rapped on the pads. There is a huge roar from the bowler there and he convinces his skipper in going upstairs. The replays roll in and this time Mpofu is fine on the front foot. Ultra Edge then confirms that there is no bat involved when the ball passes the bat. No comes the Ball Tracker and what we see is it is pitching in line, the impact is in line but the ball on hitting the stumps is umpire's call. Das survives there and the batsmen get a leg bye too.
An appeal for lbw! Zimbabwe have taken the review. Das is the man in question. Seems a close one.

Full and on off, Tamim drives to covers where Sikandar Raza misfields it to allow a single. OHH! Replays later on show that Mpofu had overstepped but the umpire did not spot that. Lucky escape for the bowler.
Chris Mpofu is on.
Full and on off, Das taps it towards backward point and looks for a non exisistent run but then  aborts it.
Full and on the pads, flicked towards square leg for a single.
On a length on middle, Liton flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Full delivery on off, Das drives it towards covers where the Wesley Madhevere makes a fine stop.
FOUR! Poor delivery from Tiripano! Full toss on leg, Das flicks it over fine leg for a boundary.
FOUR! Nicely played! Full delivery on middle, Das flicks it over square leg for a boundary.

SIX! Wow! Even mishits go over the ropes when you are in form. This is bowled on a length and outside off, Tamim comes down the track and gets it off the outside half of the bat. The ball flies it over the backward point boundary for a biggie.
FOUR! That's a gorgeous stroke. Mumba bowls one on a length and outside off, Tamim makes room and carves it uppishly over cover and into the fence for a boundary.
Short of a length ball outside off, Tamim punches it off the back foot but finds covers to perfection.
WIDE! Mumba bowls a bouncer, Iqbal lets it sail through to the keeper.
Full again on middle, Tamim lofts it over mid-wicket. The batsmen get two runs.
Full delivery on middle, Das drives it through mid on for a single.
Short delivery on middle, Iqbal pulls it through mid-wicket for a run.
Full and angled into the pads, Das flicks it to deep square leg where Ervine fields it. A couple taken in the end. Craig Ervine there showed great commitment as he has just recovered from the flu.
Length ball outside off, Tamim this time runs it down to third man with an angled bat and gets a single.
Outside off, Tamim punches it straight to covers.
BEATEN! Tiripano bowls one outside off, Iqbal looks to run it down to the third man region but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Length ball on off, pushed to point by Iqbal.

Miscommunication but safe. Tiripano bowls if fuller and outside off, Tamim looks to drive but gets an inside edge and the ball rolls towards the keeper. Das who was halfway down the track has to run back as the keeper fires in a throw to the bowler's end but misses it.
Donald Tiripano to bowl now.
Full delivery on off, Liton drives it to covers. 9 runs have come from the debutant's first over.
FOUR! Good shot! Full delivery on middle, Das flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Play and a miss! On a good length and outside off, Das looks to poke at it but misses it.
Full delivery on middle, Iqbal flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
BEATEN! Back of a length delivery outside off, Tamim looks to cut but misses it.
FOUR! Poor delivery from Mumba to begin with! Full delivery on the pads, Iqbal flicks it towards fine leg for a boundary.
Carl Mumba to bowl from the other end.

FOUR! Das is on fire. This time Raza floats one around off and Liton just lofts it off his front foot. The ball goes over mid off for a one bounce boundary. 11 from the opening over of Sikandar Raza. He started off well but the last two balls spoils it.

SIX! First maximum from the man in form and that is some way to get off the mark. Raza floats one around middle and leg, Das slog sweeps it over deep square leg and the ball goes over the fence and into the stands for a biggie.
Floated and on the pads, Das tucks it to mid-wicket.
Zimbabwe are underway! Tamim tucks this floated ball off his pads towards mid-wicket for a single.
Floated and on off, pushed to the off side.
Floated on off, pushed to point.
We are all set to begin. The Zimbabwe players are out in the middle. Tamim Iqbal and Liton Das will open the innings for Bangladesh. Sikandar Raza will start the proceedings for Zimbabwe.

Zimbabwe (Playing XI) - Sikandar Raza, Tinashe Kamunhukamwe, Craig Ervine, Brendan Taylor, Sean Williams (C), Wesley Madhevere, Richmond Mutumbami (WK), Donald Tiripano, Tinotenda Mutombodzi, Carl Mumba (T20I DEBUT), Chris Mpofu.

Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Tamim Iqbal, Liton Das , Mahedi Hasan, Mushfiqur Rahim (WK), Mahmudullah (C), Afif Hossain, Soumya Sarkar, Mohammad Saifuddin, Aminul Islam, Shafiul Islam, Mustafizur Rahman.
TOSS - It is time for the spin of the coin. Zimbabwe won the toss and elected to field.

Hello and welcome to the 1st T20I between Bangladesh and Zimbabwe in Mirpur. Bangladesh won the ODI series 3-0 and they gave a heartwarming send off to their most successful skipper Mashrafe Mortaza. The hosts would look to continue their good run in the shortest format of the game. On the other hand, Zimbabwe would want to end their losing streak. Zimbabwe would want a better performance from their team and would look to arrest their losing streak. Will Bangladesh continue their good form under a new leader or will Zimbabwe  finally get a win under their belt on this tour? Stay tuned for toss and team updates in a short while.
